name: Matsuya

gf.best: 牛焼肉定食 (Grilled Beef Set, ¥890) — Matsuya's own item page prints 小麦「－」. Also 豚ロース焼肉定食 ¥790 and the low-carb 牛焼肉生野菜セット, all 小麦「－」.
gf.detail: This is the strongest gluten result of the four gyūdon chains, and it is a complete hot meal, not a side plate. Matsuya publishes a per-item 28-allergen table (updated 2026年8月18日) AND repeats it on every product page; both show 牛焼肉定食 as 小麦－ / 大豆○ / 牛肉○ / 鶏肉△ / 豚肉△. Critically, Matsuya notes 「メインメニューにはみそ汁の栄養成分も含まれております」 — the free dine-in miso soup is already inside that row, and みそ汁 on its own is 大豆○ and nothing else. So 牛焼肉定食 = grilled beef + rice + miso soup, wheat-free by ingredient. THE DISTINCTION MATTERS AND IS EASY TO GET WRONG: 牛めし (the gyudon) is 小麦○, 松屋の牛焼肉丼 — the same beef in a bowl — is 小麦○ because the bowl gets a sauce, and カルビ焼肉定食 is 小麦○ from the カルビソース. Only the plain 焼肉 定食 is clean. Also wheat-free: ライス, 生野菜 (zero allergens; cabbage + sweetcorn), みそ汁, 豚汁, 冷奴, お新香, 国産とろろ, 鬼おろし, 焼きのり, 青ネギ, 富士山キムチ, '炙り'焼鮭, 生玉子/半熟玉子, ソーセージエッグ, 紅生姜, 七味, and the whole モーニング line (ソーセージエッグ定食, 豚汁朝定食, '炙り'焼鮭朝定食, Wで選べる玉子かけごはん). Rated limited not reliable because nothing is sealed and Matsuya states 「調理の過程上、アレルギー物質の二次混入をすべて防ぐことはできません」.

vegan.best: ライス + 冷奴 (cold tofu) + 生野菜 + お新香 + 鬼おろし + 国産とろろ
vegan.detail: No plant-based item is sold. There is no ベジ/プラントベース line on the Matsuya menu as of 2026-08-21, and the group's curry brand マイカリー食堂 (co-located inside many Matsuya branches) has no vegan curry either. But Matsuya has the widest set of animal-free sides of the four: 冷奴 (大豆○ ごま○ only), 生野菜 (zero allergens — 原産地 page confirms it is just cabbage and sweetcorn), 鬼おろし (zero allergens), お新香 (りんご○ only), 国産とろろ (やまいも○ only), 青ネギ, 焼きのり, ライス, 紅生姜. Of the counter bottles only フレンチドレッシング is free of egg/dairy (大豆○ りんご○); ごまドレッシング contains egg. UNVERIFIABLE RISK: dashi and かつお節 are not among Japan's 28 allergens, so the miso soup and any tofu tare cannot be cleared — treat みそ汁 as non-vegan. HARD TRAP: 豆乳ぷりん ('soy-milk pudding') looks vegan and is not — the table lists ゼラチン○.

both_gf_and_vegan: YES — genuinely, and this is the only one of the four gyūdon chains where it works. ライス + 冷奴 + 生野菜 + お新香 + 鬼おろし + 国産とろろ are ALL 小麦「－」 and all free of every animal allergen on Matsuya's own table. It is a cold plate rather than a hot meal, and dashi in any tofu tare stays unverifiable, but it is a real order.
caveats: 牛めし (the gyudon) is 小麦○ — wheat from the soy-sauce tare. Only the 焼肉 DEFINED AS 定食 is wheat-free.
松屋の牛焼肉丼 and カルビ焼肉定食 are both 小麦○. Same beef, different sauce. Order 牛焼肉定食 by name.
Every counter tare except French dressing contains wheat: 醤油, ポン酢だれ, バーベキューだれ, 焼肉のタレ甘口（カルビソース）, ごまドレッシング. Use salt and 紅生姜 only.
豆乳ぷりん contains ゼラチン — soy-milk pudding is not vegan.
納豆（ネギ付）is 小麦○ from its tare; ポテサラ and 炙りチーズポテト are 小麦○.
ブレンド茶 is on the drink list — Japanese blend teas commonly contain 大麦/はと麦 (barley = gluten), which the 28-item table can never show. Unconfirmed; avoid if reactive.
Matsuya's miso soup is 大豆 only (no 麦味噌, no 麩) but will contain dashi — wheat-free, not vegan.
Matsuya states outright that secondary contamination during cooking cannot be fully prevented.

phrases.ja: 牛焼肉定食をください。タレとソースは全て抜いてください。小麦アレルギーです。
phrases.romaji: Gyuu-yakiniku teishoku o kudasai. Tare to soosu wa subete nuite kudasai. Komugi arerugii desu.
phrases.en: The Grilled Beef Set Meal, please — no tare, no sauce at all. I have a wheat allergy.

phrases.ja: 牛めしではなく、牛焼肉「定食」です。丼のほうは小麦が入っています。
phrases.romaji: Gyuumeshi de wa naku, gyuu-yakiniku 'teishoku' desu. Donburi no hou wa komugi ga haitte imasu.
phrases.en: Not the beef bowl — the grilled beef SET MEAL. The bowl version contains wheat.

phrases.ja: 冷奴・生野菜・お新香・とろろ・ライスをください。動物性の材料は食べられません。
phrases.romaji: Hiyayakko, namayasai, oshinko, tororo, raisu o kudasai. Doubutsusei no zairyou wa taberaremasen.
phrases.en: Cold tofu, raw vegetables, pickles, grated yam and rice, please. I can't eat animal ingredients.

phrases.ja: 冷奴のタレにだしは入っていますか？
phrases.romaji: Hiyayakko no tare ni dashi wa haitte imasu ka?
phrases.en: Does the tofu's sauce contain fish stock (dashi)?
